by

target_source: ∀ (g g' : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (y₀ : ℝ), Summable u → (∀ n y, HasDerivAt (g n) (g' n y) y) → (∀ n y, |g' n y| ≤ u n) → Summable (fun n => g n y₀) → ∀ y, Summable (fun n => g n y) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun z => ∑' n, g n z) (∑' n, g' n y) y
